summary: Two UTV occupants were seriously injured when their vehicle rolled about 200 feet down an embankment off Stillwater Pass on September 22, 2026. Rescuers evacuated one occupant to a medical helicopter and the other to an ambulance.
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue; Grand County EMS; Grand County Sheriff's Office
notes: Reviewed October 11, 2026. The Denver Gazette report published September 23, 2026 establishes the incident year and September 22 date. It reports an iPhone crash alert, a site about 7.4 miles up the trail, 13 GCSAR responders, serious injuries to both occupants, and evacuation to medical care. Long-term outcomes are not reported. Original Facebook citation retained; independent dated news report resolves the prior preview limitation.
